# CALYPSO trades: trade (TRD)

A booked trade as its source system (ENDUR, CALYPSO or MUREX) extracts it in the common schema: the deal, its legs with their cash flows and resets, and its events. One row per trade per business date, keyed by TRADE_ID. Read by the **trading** pack's connector `trade-calypso` (table `<root>/trading/trade_endur/`). Delivered **daily**, 60 business days (2026-07-08 to 2026-09-30): the first day's file is a **full snapshot** (3,471 records); each later day's file holds only the records new or changed that day (174–373 a day). Drishti applies a day's file by key over the day before: a record absent from a day's file keeps its previous version, and nothing is ever deleted (an end is a changed status). 18,493 rows in all.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/trades/calypso/` + `changes-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz`, `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `TRADE_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the business date is the file's date (`snapshot-` or `changes-YYYY-MM-DD`), which becomes the lake's partition `business_date` |
| Promoted columns | `TRADE_ID`, `SOURCE_SYSTEM`, `PRODUCT_TYPE`, `PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE`, `PRODUCT_GROUP`, `TRADE_STATUS`, `TRADE_VERSION`, `BUY_SELL_CODE`, `CURRENCY`, `QUANTITY`, `TRADE_DATE`, `MATURITY_DATE`, `COUNTERPARTY`, `LEGAL_ENTITY`, `PORTFOLIO`, `TRADER_ID`, `NOTIONAL`, `INDEX_NAME` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date`, `PRODUCT_TYPE` |
| A day's file | a full snapshot on the first day, then only the changed records |

## Fields every sub-type has

The example is from the **FX_DOUBLE_BARRIER** record.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE_SYSTEM` | string | required | The booking system the trade comes from: ENDUR, CALYPSO or MUREX (upper case). | one of `CALYPSO`, `ENDUR`, `MUREX` | `"CALYPSO"` |
| `SOURCE_UPDATE_TIME` | timestamp (ISO-8601) | optional (filled in every row) | When the booking system last changed the trade, ISO-8601 UTC; moves with every amendment (empty on an ENDUR trade never amended). | — | `"2026-07-21T17:50:00Z"` |
| `TRADE_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the trade was agreed. | — | `"2025-02-10"` |
| `INPUT_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every row) | The day the trade was entered in the booking system (CALYPSO and MUREX: the trade date; empty on ENDUR). | — | `"2025-02-10"` |
| `TRADE_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | links to `trade` | `"CLY-4004329"` |
| `TRADE_STATUS` | string | required | Life-cycle status: NEW, VALIDATED, AMENDED, MATURED or CANCELLED. A cancellation is a new version with CANCELLED, never a deleted row; VaR counts only live statuses. | one of `AMENDED`, `CANCELLED`, `MATURED`, `NEW`, `VALIDATED` | `"VALIDATED"` |
| `TRADE_ACTION` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The last action on the trade: NEW or AMEND (empty on ENDUR when none). | one of `AMEND`, `NEW` | `"AMEND"` |
| `TRADE_VERSION` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The booking system's version of the trade, as text; it goes up by one with every amendment (empty when the system gives none). | — | `"3"` |
| `TRANSACTION_ID` | string | required | The booking system's number of this version of the trade: it changes with every amendment while TRADE_ID stays. Text. | — | `"4004329003"` |
| `QUANTITY` | number | required | The trade's quantity: units of the commodity in the leg's PRICE_UNIT for a commodity trade, else the notional or face amount in CURRENCY. Unsigned: the side is BUY_SELL_CODE. | unit: PRICE_UNIT or CURRENCY | `372048000.0` |
| `BUY_SELL_CODE` | string | required | The bank's side: B (bought, pays fixed, buys protection) or S (sold). | one of `B`, `S` | `"S"` |
| `PRODUCT_TYPE` | string | required | The product type as the booking system types it; it selects the trade's Sutra. ENDUR: ComSwap, ComFut, Cash, CallNot, Commodity; CALYPSO and MUREX: the product taxonomy code (FRA, SWAPTION_BERM, EQ_TRS, CMD_APO,...). | — | `"FX_DOUBLE_BARRIER"` |
| `PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE` | string | required | The finer type: ENDUR its sub-type code (ENGY-SWAP, ENGY-B-SWAP, ENGY-EXCH-FUT, CASH, NOSTRO, NGX-COMM-PHYS, COMM-WARRANTS-INV); CALYPSO and MUREX the product's name (Basis swap (float/float)). | — | `"FX double-barrier option"` |
| `PRODUCT_GROUP` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The asset class (Rates, FX, Credit, Equity, Commodity, Inflation, Fixed income, Money market, Securities financing, Structured); empty on ENDUR. | seen: `FX`, `Fixed income`, `Credit`, `Securities financing`, `Money market` | `"FX"` |
| `PRODUCT_SUB_GROUP` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The product family within the group (linear, option, exotic, bond, future, cds, loan, money, note,...); empty on ENDUR. | — | `"exotic"` |
| `COUNTERPARTY` | string | required | The trade's counterparty: a COUNTERPARTY_ID of the core pack's counterparty kind (CP-…). | pattern `^CP-`; links to `counterparty` | `"CP-CASCADIA"` |
| `COUNTERPARTY_UEN` | string | required | The counterparty's unique entity number in the bank's client master (UENnnnnnnn). | — | `"UEN0100148"` |
| `COUNTERPARTY_COUNTRY_OF_RISK` | string | required | The counterparty's country of risk, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. | — | `"CA"` |
| `INTERNAL_EXTERNAL_CODE` | string | required | External for a trade with a client or market counterparty; Portfolio (ENDUR's internal code) for one between two of the bank's books. | one of `External`, `Portfolio` | `"External"` |
| `TRANSIT` | string | required | The bank's branch transit number of the booking legal entity: five digits, text, leading zeros kept. | one of `00107`, `00214`, `00321`, `00428` | `"00214"` |
| `LEGAL_ENTITY` | string | required | The bank's legal entity that booked the trade: an ENTITY_ID of the core pack's legal-entity kind (LE-…). | pattern `^LE-`; links to `legal-entity` | `"LE-LDN"` |
| `PORTFOLIO` | string | required | The book the trade is booked in: a BOOK_ID of the core pack's book kind (BOOK-…). | pattern `^BOOK-`; links to `book` | `"BOOK-FX-3"` |
| `TRADER_ID` | string | required | The trader who booked it: a TRADER_ID of the core pack's trader kind (TRDR-…). | pattern `^TRDR-`; links to `trader` | `"TRDR-LMOREAU"` |
| `TRADER_FIRST_NAME` | string | required | The trader's first name or initial, as the booking system keeps it. | — | `"L."` |
| `TRADER_LAST_NAME` | string | required | The trader's last name, as the booking system keeps it. | — | `"Moreau"` |
| `START_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The trade's start (effective) date. | — | `"2025-02-12"` |
| `MATURITY_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The trade's final maturity (last payment or expiry) date. | — | `"2027-06-01"` |
| `CURRENCY` | string | required | The trade's currency, ISO 4217. | one of `AUD`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY`, `USD` | `"CAD"` |
| `DELIVERY_VERSUS_PAYMENT` | string | required | YES when the instrument and the cash change hands together (securities), else NO. | one of `NO`, `YES` | `"NO"` |
| `TT_GROUP` | string | optional (filled in every row) | CALYPSO and MUREX: the desk of the trade, a DESK_ID of the core pack's desk kind (DESK-…); empty on ENDUR. Carried through; not read by Drishti. | pattern `^DESK-`; links to `desk` | `"DESK-FX"` |
| `TT_BOOK` | string | optional (filled in every row) | CALYPSO and MUREX: the trade's book, a BOOK_ID of the core pack's book kind (BOOK-…), the same as PORTFOLIO; empty on ENDUR. | pattern `^BOOK-`; links to `book` | `"BOOK-FX-3"` |
| `SETTLEMENT_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every row) | The day the trade settles (CALYPSO and MUREX: the start date; empty on ENDUR). | — | `"2025-02-12"` |
| `LEGS` | array of objects | required | The trade's legs, in LEG_ID order: one object per leg (a swap has two, a future or a cash deal one). | — | [1 objects] |
| `LEGS[].LEG_ID` | string | required | The leg's number within the trade (1, 2,...), text; EVENTS[].LEG_ID names it. | — | `"1"` |
| `LEGS[].LEG_TYPE` | string | required | FIXED, FLOAT (set by an index), OPTION or PHYSICAL. | one of `FIXED`, `FLOAT`, `OPTION`, `PHYSICAL` | `"OPTION"` |
| `LEGS[].LEG_ECONOMIC_TYPE` | string | optional (filled in every `LEGS[]` entry) | CALYPSO and MUREX: Pay or Receive (whether the bank pays or receives the leg's flows); ENDUR: what the leg is (Fixed price, Floating price, Basis, Fee), empty when not given. | one of `Basis`, `Fee`, `Fixed price`, `Floating price`, `Pay`, `Receive` | `"Receive"` |
| `LEGS[].CURRENCY` | string | required | The leg's currency, ISO 4217. | one of `AUD`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY`, `USD` | `"CAD"` |
| `LEGS[].NOTIONAL` | number | required | The leg's amount: quantity times price for a commodity leg, the principal for a rates leg, in the leg's CURRENCY. | unit: leg currency | `372048000.0` |
| `LEGS[].SETTLEMENT_TYPE` | string | required | Cash Settlement or Physical Settlement. | one of `Cash Settlement`, `Physical Settlement` | `"Cash Settlement"` |
| `LEGS[].NUM_PROFILE_REC` | string | optional (filled in every `LEGS[]` entry) | The number of profile (flow) records the booking system holds for the leg, as text: the length of CASH_FLOWS on CALYPSO and MUREX; empty on ENDUR. Not read by Drishti. | — | `"17"` |
| `LEGS[].INDEX` | object | required | The leg's floating index: NAME, GROUP and SUB_GROUP, each empty on a fixed leg. | — | {…} |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS` | array of objects | required | The leg's periods: each with its dates, notional, rate or price, and its resets. | — | [17 objects] |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].FLOW_ID` | string | required | The flow's number in the booking system, unique within the system; text. | — | `"4004329001"` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].NOTIONAL` | number | required | The flow's notional (for a commodity flow its quantity times price), in the leg's currency. | unit: leg currency | `372048000.0` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].START_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The first day of the flow's accrual or pricing period. | — | `"2025-02-12"` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].END_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The last day of the flow's accrual or pricing period. | — | `"2025-05-12"` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].PAYMENT_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The day the flow is paid. | — | `"2025-05-12"` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].STRIKE_PRICE` | number | required | The flow's strike or fixed price (an option's strike rate; ENDUR a fixed leg's price); 0.0 when none. | — | `0.0` |
| `EVENTS` | array of objects | required | The trade's life-cycle and cash events, in EVENT_NUMBER order: one object per event (an empty array when none). | — | [5 objects] |
| `EVENTS[].EVENT_ID` | string | optional (filled in every `EVENTS[]` entry) | The event's number in the booking system; text. | — | `"4004329001"` |
| `EVENTS[].EVENT_NUMBER` | integer | optional (filled in every `EVENTS[]` entry) | The event's position among the trade's events (1, 2,...). | — | `1` |
| `EVENTS[].EVENT_TYPE` | string | optional (filled in every `EVENTS[]` entry) | What happened or will: CASH_SETTLEMENT, FEE, RESET, AMENDMENT, NOVATION (ENDUR), BOOKED, CONFIRMED, CLEARED, AMENDED, CASH_SETTLED, NEXT_PAYMENT, PARTIALLY_TERMINATED, MATURITY (CALYPSO, MUREX); may be empty on ENDUR. | — | `"BOOKED"` |
| `EVENTS[].EVENT_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every `EVENTS[]` entry) | The day of the event; for a cash event the day the cash moves. | — | `"2025-02-10"` |
| `EVENTS[].CURRENCY` | string | optional (filled in every `EVENTS[]` entry) | The currency of the event's amount, ISO 4217. | one of `AUD`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY`, `USD` | `"CAD"` |
| `EVENTS[].SEQUENCE_NUMBER` | integer | optional (filled in every `EVENTS[]` entry) | The event's order in the booking system (equal to EVENT_NUMBER in the test data). | — | `1` |
| `EVENTS[].LEG_ID` | string | optional (filled in 55% of `EVENTS[]` entries) | The leg the event belongs to (a LEGS[].LEG_ID); empty for a deal-level event (BOOKED, CONFIRMED, MATURITY...). | — | `"1"` |
| `EVENTS[].PAYMENT_TYPE` | string | optional (filled in 55% of `EVENTS[]` entries) | What a cash event pays (Interest, Premium, Commodity payment, Fee, Amendment fee, Novation fee, Fixing, Adjustment, Futures settlement, Cash payment, Caplet,... or the accrual period START..END); empty for a non-cash event. | seen: `Interest`, `Premium`, `Amendment fee`, `Adjustment` | `"Amendment fee"` |
| `EVENTS[].AMOUNT` | number | optional (filled in 57% of `EVENTS[]` entries) | The event's cash amount from the bank's side, in EVENTS[].CURRENCY: negative is paid, positive received; empty for a non-cash event. | unit: event currency | `-257423.49` |

## One record of each sub-type

Each record is real, the most complete of its sub-type, pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data. Below each record, the fields it has beyond the shared table.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `TRADE_ID` per `business_date`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `SOURCE_SYSTEM`, `TRADE_DATE`, `TRADE_ID`, `TRADE_STATUS`, `TRANSACTION_ID`, `QUANTITY`, `BUY_SELL_CODE`, `PRODUCT_TYPE`, `PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE`, `COUNTERPARTY`, `COUNTERPARTY_UEN`, `COUNTERPARTY_COUNTRY_OF_RISK`, `INTERNAL_EXTERNAL_CODE`, `TRANSIT`, `LEGAL_ENTITY`, `PORTFOLIO`, `TRADER_ID`, `TRADER_FIRST_NAME`, `TRADER_LAST_NAME`, `START_DATE`, `MATURITY_DATE`, `CURRENCY`, `DELIVERY_VERSUS_PAYMENT`, `LEGS`, `EVENTS` (the contract's required fields); every row of the test data also fills `SOURCE_UPDATE_TIME`, `INPUT_DATE`, `TRADE_ACTION`, `TRADE_VERSION`, `PRODUCT_GROUP`, `PRODUCT_SUB_GROUP`, `TT_GROUP`, `TT_BOOK`, `SETTLEMENT_DATE`.
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- `TRADE_ID` is text, unique across the source systems; a JSON number is read as text, leading zeros kept.
- Every day sends the trades new or changed that day (or the whole book): an amendment is the whole trade again with `TRADE_VERSION` raised, `TRADE_ACTION` and `TRANSACTION_ID` new and `SOURCE_UPDATE_TIME` later; a cancellation is the trade again with `TRADE_STATUS` `CANCELLED`. A trade is never deleted from the files.
- Missing values may be spelt `""` as the extracts do; the screens read them with `nonblank`.
- `EVENTS[].AMOUNT` is signed: paid negative, received positive.
- Each day: the records new or changed that day (or all of them); Drishti keeps the rest from the day before.
- Unique: `TRADE_ID` per business_date.
